## Section 7: Healthcare impact: illustrative case {#sec-appendix7 .unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-num_healtcare_1
#| tbl-cap: "Public health impact metrics from the numerical experiment, translating relative stockout rates into estimated losses in mCRP, users, unintended pregnancies, abortions, and infant deaths. Estimates assume a population of 100,000 women of reproductive age and 10 contraceptive products. (Part 1)"

method_count <- 10
wra_population <- 100000


healthcare_impact_num <- inv_metrics_num_summary |> 
  filter(!policy %in% c('oracle', 'capped')) |> 
  select(model, policy, stockout_rate) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  left_join(inv_metrics_num_summary |> 
              filter(model == 'TCKF') |> 
              select(policy, stockout_rate) |> 
              distinct() |> 
              rename(stockout_rate_bench = stockout_rate),
            by = c('policy')) |> 
  mutate(mcpr_loss = round(0.065 * method_count * (stockout_rate - stockout_rate_bench),3),
         users_lost = mcpr_loss * wra_population,
         maternal_deaths = users_lost / 3153,
         infant_deaths = users_lost / 251,
         abortions = users_lost / 6.46,
         unintended_pregnancies = users_lost / 3.63)


df_rel_num <- healthcare_impact_num |>
  group_by(policy, model) |>
  summarise(mcpr_loss = round(mean(mcpr_loss, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
            users_lost = round(mean(users_lost, na.rm = TRUE)),
            infant_deaths = round(mean(infant_deaths, na.rm = TRUE)),
            abortions  = round(mean(abortions, na.rm = TRUE)),
            unintended_pregnancies = round(mean(unintended_pregnancies, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = 'drop')


df_rel_num_wide <- df_rel_num |>
  filter(!policy %in% c('capped', 'oracle', 
                                   'upper_q80', 'upper_q85', 'upper_q90', 'upper_q95')) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  mutate(policy = factor(policy,
                        levels = c("deterministic", 'myopic (k=5)', 'myopic (k=10)', 'myopic (k=20)'))) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols    = model,
    names_from = policy,
    values_from = c(mcpr_loss, users_lost, infant_deaths, abortions, unintended_pregnancies),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{policy}"  
  ) %>% 
  {
    cols <- colnames(.)
    pols <- unique(sub("^(mcpr_loss_|users_lost_|infant_deaths_|abortions_|unintended_pregnancies_)", "", cols[!cols %in% "model"]))
    ord  <- c("model", as.vector(rbind(paste0("mcpr_loss_", pols), paste0("users_lost_", pols), paste0("infant_deaths_", pols), paste0("abortions_", pols), paste0("unintended_pregnancies_", pols))))
    select(., all_of(ord))
  }

colnames(df_rel_num_wide) <- c(
  "Method",
  # deterministic
  'Rel mCRP Loss (%)', 'Rel Users Loss', 'Rel Infant Deaths', 'Rel Abortions', 'Rel Unintended Pregnancies',
  # myopic (k=5)
  'Rel mCRP Loss (%)', 'Rel Users Loss', 'Rel Infant Deaths', 'Rel Abortions', 'Rel Unintended Pregnancies',
  # myopic (k=10)
  'Rel mCRP Loss (%)', 'Rel Users Loss', 'Rel Infant Deaths', 'Rel Abortions', 'Rel Unintended Pregnancies',
  # myopic (k=20)
  'Rel mCRP Loss (%)', 'Rel Users Loss', 'Rel Infant Deaths', 'Rel Abortions', 'Rel Unintended Pregnancies'
)

df_rel_num_wide |>
  knitr::kable(booktabs = T, linesep = "") |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 5, latex_options = "scale_down") |>
  landscape() |>
  column_spec(1, width = "8em") |>
  column_spec(2:21, width = "4em") |> 
  add_header_above(c(
    " " = 1,
    "Deterministic" = 5,
    "Myopic (k=5)" = 5,
    "Myopic (k=10)" = 5,
    "Myopic (k=20)" = 5
  ))

```

wra_population <- 1590000
